title: x1F enters the German Camunda cohort on size alone; its positioning is unresolved
content:
x1F is in the German Camunda cohort on size alone. The resolved facts are EUR 177.7m in revenue and a Lunendonk rank of 21; the Camunda attribution is unverified and the assessment records the firm's positioning as unresolved.

Recording that honestly is more useful than filling the gap with a guess. Two of the three things that would make this lead interesting — what it runs and what it sells itself as — are unknown, and the third, its size, is the axis on which large firms in this set are usually deprioritised. It sits at priority 3 with verification as the next step, and if the Camunda footprint does not confirm, the entry has no remaining basis.
